card.title: Little Jamaica and Oakwood Vaughan Planning Framework
card.what_is_proposed: A draft planning framework sets out how future development may relate to local culture, community priorities and the public realm.
card.why: The draft is intended as a basis for community and stakeholder consultation before final recommendations.
card.who_is_affected: People and organizations in the four wards listed for Little Jamaica and Oakwood Vaughan.

stages.quote: This item was considered by Planning and Housing Committee on April 14, 2026 and was adopted with amendments.

conditions: The April 2026 committee decision requested consultation and a report in Q4 2026; this is a historical direction, not proof that a final framework was adopted.
The official City project page now anticipates the Final Report being shared with Planning and Housing Committee in Q1 2027; this is a projected next step.
The City project page confirms the Stakeholder Advisory Committee has launched. The mapping activity is a separate public feedback channel.

participation.deadline_text: November 30, 2026 (Interactive Consultation Mapping tool; no time of day specified)
participation.how: Use the City of Toronto's Interactive Consultation Mapping tool linked in this panel to provide feedback on the Little Jamaica and Oakwood Vaughan Planning Framework.
participation.quote: The map is open for feedback from April 24th to November 30th, 2026.

procedural_phrases.meaning_here: The committee approved its own amended directions; this is not evidence of final Council adoption of the planning framework.

uncertainties: The agenda item's April decision does not state the current consultation deadline; the deadline comes from the later City project website and its linked mapping portal.
The online mapping tool could close or be extended; verify its current status at the official project portal before submitting.
The planning framework is still a draft; no City Council final approval of the completed framework is established by this item.

independent_source_crosscheck: City of Toronto project page and its linked consultation portal, checked 2026-11-12; no team human sign-off
